account.endOfTerm.selected: Demo selection shown on this page only. Nothing has been submitted or changed.

return.pending: Thank you for using our service. You will receive information about your return soon.
return.processing: Your return is being processed. We will update you as it progresses.
return.ready: Your item has been approved and is available again.
return.rejected: Your return needs follow-up. The company will contact you with more information.

assetDetails.leaseIntro: You are about to start a lease for this item.
assetDetails.leaseNextStep: The application flow will continue here.
lease.reservationError: This item is no longer available. Please go back and choose another item.
lease.complete: Your answers are complete. We can now review your leasing application.
lease.validationError: This answer does not meet the leasing requirements. The application cannot continue.
lease.leaveWarning: Leaving will cancel this leasing process and release the item immediately. Do you want to leave?
lease.bindingWarning: This is a binding leasing contract. By selecting Finish, you confirm that you want to submit and sign it.
lease.signingError: The application could not be approved and signed. Please review the details and try again.
engine.demoNote: Demo controls use contract dates. Invoices are not marked paid. Net rent is locked; VAT follows the invoice date.
engine.awaitingReturn: Lease completed. Asset remains reserved pending physical return and refurbishment.
circular.title: Operator workshop and asset passports
circular.demo: Development company workspace. Confirm actual work before review. Dates follow the explicit lease timeline.
circular.imported: Earlier lives are imported summaries; their individual events are not available.
circular.matches: Eligible demand: earliest deadline, then stable request ID
circular.finish: Confirm completed work and submit for approval
circular.pendingApproval: Work is complete. The asset remains unavailable until company approval.
circular.rejected: Proposal rejected. The asset remains unavailable.
circular.emptyReturned: There are no submitted returns waiting for company operations.
circular.confirm: Confirm each completed task. Mandatory work cannot be skipped.
end.recorded: Settlement obligation recorded; payment is not recorded
end.policy: Early-return policy: at a monthly boundary, fee is the lower of remaining net rents and the signed end buyout. No admin fee. Ordinary end return is free; buyout is separate.
end.totalNet: Total net if bought at term end
end.taxHint: VAT is additional and can change; buyout is optional.
lease.underage: You must be at least 18 on the lease start date. You can explore the catalogue and apply when eligible.
lease.manualReview: A person needs to review this application before signing can continue.
circular.steps: Receive the physical item → inspect → complete required work → company approval → publish the next offer.
circular.empty: No lease test items yet. Complete a lease and choose Return to start.
circular.review: Workshop work saved. This item cannot be financed at its estimated net value and stays unavailable pending operator pricing review. Estimated value:
circular.conflict: This item or request has changed, or a required step is missing. Reload and check the return, inspection and required tasks before retrying.
operator.loginError: Sign-in failed. Check the operator password configured in the local environment.
operator.access: Company workspace. Sign in separately to manage leases, physical returns and offer approvals. Development access only.
operator.pending: Work completed — waiting for company approval. Proposed net price:
operator.returnInstructions: Arrange physical handover with the operator. Your return choice is recorded; the operator confirms receipt and inspection.
smart.taxExplanation: Your signed net rent stays fixed. VAT follows the invoice date, so a tax change can change the total without changing your net rent.
smart.forecastNote: Projection, not issued invoices or payments. Uses signed net rent and current challenge tax rules; the 2027 Finnish VAT change is fictional. Dates are monthly anniversaries clamped to month end, with the agreed payment period.
smart.taxChanged: VAT changes; net rent stays fixed
journey.demoHelp: Testing only: jump to this lease’s agreed end date to try the end-of-lease choices. This does not record payment or physical return.
journey.demoConfirm: Yes, simulate the agreed end date
journey.activeHelp: Keep using your item. You can view invoices below. When the lease ends, choose to return it, pass it on, or buy it.
journey.completed: Your lease has ended — choose what happens next
journey.completedHelp: Choose one option below. Returning or passing on the item requires physical handover; the company handles inspection, repairs and approval.
journey.savedHelp: Your next step is explained below. You do not need to operate the workshop yourself.
journey.returnHelp: Give the item back. Choose this option, enter its current usage, and send the return request. The company receives a notification and confirms physical receipt separately.
journey.passHelp: Return the item for another customer. The company inspects and approves it before a new contract.
journey.buyHelp: Keep the item by recording the contractual buyout amount shown below. This does not confirm payment.
journey.earlyHelp: Demo early exit in month 7. The agreed fee applies; you must still return the physical item.
journey.buyoutNext: The buyout amount has been recorded. Arrange payment and ownership handover with the company; no payment has been confirmed here.
journey.companyHandling: The company has registered your item. They handle inspection, refurbishment and review; you do not need to use the workshop.
journey.returnDone: Your return has been processed and the item has been approved for its next lease. No workshop action is needed from you.
notification.title: Return notifications
notification.empty: No return requests awaiting physical receipt.
notification.error: Unable to refresh return notifications. Open the queue to check.
notification.signIn: Sign in to company operations to see return requests.
circular.dateError: The approval date is earlier than the completed work. Reload the workshop to use the item’s demo timeline, then approve again.
